setup_curve_card.title: Configure HCL Curve
setup_curve_card.description:
To customize your lighting curve, please add the **HCL Curve Card** to your dashboard.

1. Go to your Dashboard
2. Edit Dashboard -> Add Card
3. Select 'Manual' and enter:

```yaml
type: custom:hcl-curve-card
entity: sensor.hcl_lighting_curve
```
